title: Product Catalog Search API, Autocomplete & Custom Macro Meal Logging
acceptance_criteria: Implement GET /api/v1/products/search?query=...&limit=10 in backend with case-insensitive search across name and brand in PostgreSQL products table.
Update POST /api/v1/meals/log to accept optional custom nutrition values (calories, protein, fat, carbs) from client rather than overriding with hardcoded 120/6/4/15 fallback.
Fix 'pcs' calculation in MealEndpoints so piece items (like eggs, bananas) compute realistic per-unit macros rather than multiplying by 100g ratios blindly.
Add live search autocomplete dropdown in MealLogForm.tsx and AddInventoryModal.tsx that queries GET /api/v1/products/search as user types.
Selecting a searched product auto-fills product name, unit, and exact per-100g or per-piece nutritional values.
